So let us define PUSH and POP macros to produce something like
(PUSH X L)   ==>  (SETQ L (CONS X L))
(POP L)      ==>  (PROG2 () (CAR L) (SETQ L (CDR L)))
This way, the value left by the "POP" will be the thing  popped off.
